message: We hold the '482 patent covering MMS photo-upload and sharing on smartphones. You have agreed it is valid and infringed by your MMS feature. In our prior letter we proposed approximately $0.28 per phone, reflecting $43.61 profit per handset, 6.2% camera cost contribution, 20.5% MMS usage, and a 50/50 split — roughly $29 million over the patent term on projected sales. We now offer to resolve this in a single lump-sum payment of {{offer}}.
